'''Docking Bay 13''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamuir IV]]. A team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] berthed their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in Docking Bay 13 when they visited the world in any attempt to acquire [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]].<ref name="MF">{{WEGCite|story=The Mecetti File|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
